title: Yaad aayega abbas magar laut kar nahi
body:
Aye meri sakina..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum bhej to rahi ho bus itna yaad rakhna
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jaane ki tum ijazat inko dila rahi ho
tumko khabar nahi hai kya karne jaa rahi ho
ye jaake laut aaye mumkin nahi sakina
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bachpan mein inki godi gehwara tha tumhara
maa banke tumko bibi abbas ne hai paala
ro'oge jab to kiska tumko milega shaana
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Saaya utha jo inka phir chayn na milega phir kaun haath sar pe yu'n pyaar se rakhega
ro ro ke phir sadayein ammu ko tum na dena
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye baat raaz ki hai tumko bata raha hu
zainab se aaj tak mai jisko chupa raha hu
baad inke phir mera bhi mumkin nahi hai jeena
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Do haath khoo'n mein doobe dekho agar kahi'n to
seene se dum nikalta mehsoos hoga tumko
wo haath chum kar bus seene se tum lagana
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Barsaat pattharo'n ki dekhi to kya karogi
thamogi haath kiska naaqe se jab girogi
taqdeer mein hai likkha bazaar e shaam jana
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zindaan ke andhere tanhaiyo'n ka aalam
us par sitam ye hoga dooba lahu mein parcham
ek zakhmi mashk uspar dekho to khoob rona
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kehti hai ye sakina 'rehan' jaise ab bhi
ammu ko mere laado mangungi ab na paani
nauha kuna raza ho jaise ke qaid khana
<<MINI>>
yaad aayega abbas, magar laut kar nahi
tum bhej to rahi ho bus itna yaad rakhna
